title: Sparkline and trend chart components with prerender
description:
As a publication builder, I want an 8-week inline sparkline and a two-series weekly trend chart, so that trends appear on entity and topic pages.

Sparkline is prerendered inline SVG at snapshot time, decorative and hidden from screen readers, with the figure (for example the percent change) as text beside it. Trend chart is an island with prerender and an optional annotation for a week. Cold-start states: under 4 weeks of history, no sparkline or percent and the chip says "new"; 4 to 7 weeks, sparkline without percent; 8 or more, full; the 26-week chart appears only after 12 weeks.

```gherkin
Feature: Sparkline and trend chart
  Scenario: Cold start
    Given an entity with 3 weeks of history
    Then no sparkline and no percent are shown and the label says "new"

  Scenario: Full history
    Given an entity with 8 weeks of history
    Then the sparkline and the percent change are shown

  Scenario: No script
    When JavaScript does not run
    Then the sparkline is still visible
```
